trial_court: Court of Sh. Snehil Sharma, Judicial Magistrate First Class, NI Act, South West, Dwarka Delhi (CC No: 23921/2019)
case_name: Viman Dev Nath vs Ranjeet Kumar Biswas

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Viman Dev Nath, s/o Sh. Niranjan Dev Nath
parties.respondent_defendant: Ranjeet Kumar Biswas @ Ranjib, Prop. Of 'Sur Sangam Kala Academy'

facts_of_case: Complainant gave friendly loans to accused and his partner Ms. Radha Dass; accused assured payment within certain timeframes but failed to do so.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the complainant to prove that the accused had issued the cheque in question.
legal_principles.held: He was not very sure about the date. The material particulars like name of payee and amount were filled by the accused himself.

legal_principles.principle: A complainant's statement that the accused had not returned any amount between the period of initially advancing a sum and thereafter, a sum to the accused is relevant in determining whether the cheque was issued in favour of the complainant.
legal_principles.held: Complainant stated that accused had not returned any amount between the period of initially advancing of a sum of Rs.4,90,000/- and thereafter, a sum of Rs.1,10,000/- to the accused.

outcome.final_order: Accused Ranjeet Kumar Biswas @ Ranjib is acquitted for offences punishable under sections 138 NI Act.

use_for_drafting: drafting a complaint under section 138 NI Act
defending an accused in a cheque bounce case
advising on the implications of acquittal
